title: Original TripoSR 2024 demonstration reproduction — official robot
exact_demo_preprocessing: The official gradio_app.run_example uses preprocess(image, False, 0.9). Any input alpha is composited onto neutral 0.5 gray; no rembg and no foreground resize.

reconstruction.baked_texture_512: Generated and exported validated GLB, but preview shows speckled/atlas artifacts; not established as visually superior to vertex colors

findings: Original robot reconstructed with recognizably accurate front-facing face, headphone masses and body; produced much more persuasive result than Forge V23.
Direct neural rendering appears smoother than identical isosurface extraction; raw mesh still contains visible rippling and shape imprecision.
Predicted vertex colors improve perceived visual fidelity without modifying polygon geometry.
Published 2024 illustration is a visual comparison, not accessible original mesh: no exact shape-to-shape distance vs the publisher's output can be computed.
Full production Forge geometry unchanged; original V23 remains better editable baseline.
recommendation: Keep the verified inference code; prioritize separating model inference from mesh refinement, and use original V23 for actual hard-surface design. Optional texture baking merits padding/resolution validation on 3D viewer before promotion.
